title: Groups store has no cap on groups or members
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/groups_collection.py

self.groups is an unbounded dict (84). _create inserts one record per POST (144). _join_key appends to members with no max (291-293). rekey() appends to retired_epochs forever and never prunes expired entries (158-164).

CBOR mutation limits cap a single payload at 4096 bytes (cbor_validation.py) but not the number of groups or members. Peer-reachable POST /groups and POST /groups/{id}/key (no auth today) can grow RAM without bound. deaddrop.py and confessions.py enforce storage/rate limits for the same class of CoAP resource on constrained nodes.

Also no rate limit on encrypted create, which calls os.urandom(32) and stores key material per group.
acceptance_criteria: Enforce documented caps (max groups per node, max members per group, max retired_epochs retained) and prune expired retired epochs. Excess create/join returns 4.13 or 5.03 with a CBOR reason, consistent with deaddrop storage-full handling.
